info.name: BeautyNest Full API Suite (v1.0)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for BeautyNest — encompassing Customer REST API, Worker/Beautician REST API, and Admin Control Panel endpoints with dynamic JWT & session token management.

item.name: 1. Customer API
item.description: Endpoints consumed by the BeautyNest Customer Mobile App. Enhanced booking flow: Login → Pick City → Pick Date (next 7 days) → Pick Time Slot → Review Consent & Product Kit Choice → Address → Confirm Booking (COD or online).

request.description: Refreshes the access token. Accepts refresh_token in body or Bearer token in Authorization header.
Returns current authenticated user: name, email, phone, role, avatar_url.

item.name: Categories & Services
item.description: Browse the service catalog. Start with categories, drill into subcategories, then view services.

request.description: Lists subcategories with their services for the chosen category.
Returns full service details with effective price for the chosen city.

query.description: Search keyword for debouncing search-as-you-type (matches name, description, tags, category, subcategory)

request.description: Debounced live search endpoint for mobile & web search bars. Returns matching services ordered by relevance, with effective pricing, ratings, and category details. Publicly accessible without auth token.
Standalone alias for services search. Publicly accessible.

query.description: Returns trending / featured services when search bar is focused before typing

request.description: Returns popular services to display as search recommendations when user focuses the search input before typing.

item.name: Booking Flow (Enhanced)
item.description: The complete booking journey: Step 1 — choose city, Step 2 — pick date (next 7 days), Step 3 — pick time slot, Step 4 — get consent & product kit policy, Step 5 — choose/add address, Step 6 — confirm booking (with consent, product kit choice & GPS coordinates). Dynamic tiered pricing (Bronze 1.0x, Silver 1.25x, Gold 1.5x) is applied based on the assigned specialist.

request.description: Returns admin-configured cities where BeautyNest operates. Customer picks one city to begin booking.

query.description: City ID or slug from Step 1

request.description: Returns the next 7 days with availability status based on whether workers are scheduled in the chosen city. is_available: true means at least one specialist is on duty.

exec: var avail = dates.find(function(d) { return d.is_available; }) || dates[0];

request.description: Returns 8 standard time slots (09:00 AM – 07:30 PM) for the selected city & date. is_available: true means at least one worker is free at that time.

exec: var avail = slots.find(function(s) { return s.is_available; }) || slots[0];

item.name: Step 4: Get Service Consent Form & Product Policy

request.description: Returns current service consent requirements, legal title, version, terms text, and product sourcing policy (own products vs platform sanitized kit + surcharge fee).
Returns saved addresses for the customer. Pick one to use for service delivery.
Add a new delivery address inline if no saved address exists or customer wants to add one.

body.raw:
{
  "booking": {
    "service_id": "{{sampleServiceId}}",
    "city_id": "{{sampleCityId}}",
    "date": "{{sampleBookingDate}}",
    "time_slot": "{{sampleTimeSlot}}",
    "address_id": "{{sampleAddressId}}",
    "coupon_code": "WELCOME20",
    "payment_method": "cod",
    "consent_accepted": true,
    "product_source": "platform",
    "customer_latitude": 19.0760,
    "customer_longitude": 72.8777,
    "notes": "Please ring the doorbell on arrival."
  }
}

request.description: Confirms booking with platform-supplied sanitized beauty kit. Validates consent ('consent_accepted: true'), applies the admin platform product kit fee (₹150), scales service price by worker tier multiplier (Bronze 1.00x, Silver 1.25x, Gold 1.50x), snapshots GPS coordinates, auto-assigns available specialist, and creates COD payment.

item.name: Step 6b: Confirm Booking (COD - Customer Brings Own Products)

body.raw:
{
  "booking": {
    "service_id": "{{sampleServiceId}}",
    "city_id": "{{sampleCityId}}",
    "date": "{{sampleBookingDate}}",
    "time_slot": "{{sampleTimeSlot}}",
    "address_id": "{{sampleAddressId}}",
    "payment_method": "cod",
    "consent_accepted": true,
    "product_source": "customer",
    "customer_latitude": 19.0760,
    "customer_longitude": 72.8777,
    "notes": "Customer provides own beauty products; platform kit fee is waived."
  }
}

request.description: Booking where customer provides their own products ('product_source: customer'). The platform product kit fee is waived (₹0.00). Consent acceptance is still verified and recorded.

item.name: Coupons
item.description: View available promotional coupons and validate coupon codes before checkout.

request.description: Returns all active, non-expired promotional coupons available to customers.
Returns available coupons with calculated discount amounts and is_applicable flags for the specified order amount.
Validates whether a coupon code is valid, active, and applicable for the given amount, returning discount details.
Get detailed terms and discount values for a specific coupon code.

item.name: My Bookings
item.description: View and manage bookings after they have been confirmed.

request.description: Cancels a booking that is still in pending or confirmed status.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Customer reviews for completed bookings and completed services.

request.description: Submits a review for a completed booking. Updates the assigned worker's rating and connects the primary booked service.
Lists all reviews submitted by the authenticated customer for their bookings.
Submits a review for a specific service. Requires that the authenticated customer has completed a booking for this service (service_status == 'completed').

query.description: Filter reviews by Service UUID or slug (Publicly accessible)

request.description: Retrieves customer reviews for a service. Publicly accessible without authentication.

item.name: Wishlist
item.description: Customer wishlist and favorites management — add/remove services, toggle heart status, check status, and list all wishlisted services.

request.description: Fetch all services saved to the authenticated customer's wishlist with full pricing, category, rating, and duration details.
Add a service to customer's wishlist. Accepts service_id (UUID or slug).
Toggle heart status for a service. If already wishlisted, removes it. If not, adds it.
Quickly check if a specific service is in customer's wishlist (returns in_wishlist boolean).
Remove an item from wishlist using either service_id (UUID or slug) or favorite item ID.
Clear all items from the customer's wishlist.

request.description: Refreshes an access token for worker without requiring password re-entry. Returns identical response schema to worker login.
